description: Core payload families of profile 2.0 (Hub #842). `valid` holds at least one message for every family and every message kind they use. Each invalid case copies a valid message and sets the JSON pointers in `set`; null removes the member. `detail` pins where it fails. Each scenario applies valid messages in order to the reference consumer copy in tests/consumer.mjs and names the messages whose payloads remain.

invalid.name: a session as its own parent
a lifecycle session as its own parent
an id that is not the identity key
a subject that is not the entity
read evidence from the Codex CLI
a Claude session claiming the Desktop client
a host session ID on a child
a session record sent as an occurrence
invalid.detail: envelope /kind session is a state family

invalid.name: a session record under another type
a mode request naming a device
a moment request naming a controller
a moment request in a controller clock
a moment shorter than one second
a start window over one minute
a start more than a minute ahead
invalid.detail: payload /startAtMs more than 60000 ms after time

invalid.name: a mood outside the kebab-case vocabulary
a moment ending that is not one of the four
a failed operation without its error
a dismissal list with a repeated display
playback without an observation claiming availability
a lifecycle observation under another subject
an inbox item under another subject
an inbox item for another session
an operation evidence outside the profile
current freshness five minutes after the last evidence
uncertain freshness with recent evidence and no restart
a raised attention from another turn
a cleared attention without its own turn

scenarios.name: a retired subtree is removed entity by entity
a deleted inbox item is removed
a late state with an older revision does not bring a removed session back
a sync drops entities the consumer still held and keeps other families
live messages at or below the sync revision are stale after the sync
an entity above the sync revision survives the sync
a removal that arrives during a sync stays removed after it
